summary: You sit bottom of the table on 79 points, so you process first this week if these players are still free when the run happens. Woltemade (loaned out to Juventus) and Eze (stuck behind Arsenal's front line) are clear-cut drops; fresh reporting keeps Munoz as a drop too, since he is still fighting Ola Aina for Forest's right-back berth. Garner stays a lower-confidence hedge - his recovery from groin surgery is trending up faster than the model credits. No fifth claim: a fresh pundit projection has Marmoush inside Tottenham's actual strongest XI going forward, not just a one-off debut start, which only strengthens the case for keeping him well above his 0.35 model rating; the rest of the squad - including Bijol, whose two rivals for the Leeds centre-back shirt (Rodon, Gruev) are both still injured - is performing at or above its model number.

Hill, by contrast, was named in Bournemouth's most recent predicted XI alongside Silva and Truffert in the back line - an every-week starter.

claims.why: Woltemade left Newcastle for Juventus on a season-long loan on deadline day, so he plays in Serie A, not the Premier League, until at least next summer - a mandatory drop, not a judgement call. Igor Jesus is confirmed as Forest's starting lone striker in their 3-4-2-1, picked ahead of Chris Wood, who is still managing his fitness after an injury-hit campaign.
claims.model: Model: Igor Jesus next5 14.5 vs Woltemade 5.5, +9.0. Fully agree - Woltemade's number was already the worst in your squad and the loan makes it categorical rather than just weak.
